hero.title_main: Reclaiming control over our social connections
hero.subtitle: Millions of Canadians want to leave toxic American Big Tech platforms. But nobody wants to be the first to jump alone. Commit conditionally: take the leap once your circle of friends and your region are ready!

ecosystem.title: Where are we migrating to?
ecosystem.subtitle: Sovereign social networks are not algorithmic prisons: they are decentralized, ad-free, and locally hosted.
ecosystem.fediverse_desc: Thousands of independent, interconnected servers. Just like email, you can follow anyone regardless of their home server.
ecosystem.bluesky_desc: An open architecture providing total choice of algorithms and full portability of your account and followers.
ecosystem.matrix_desc: End-to-end encrypted, sovereign, and self-hostable communication protocols to replace closed big tech messengers.
ecosystem.canada_instances: Canadian-hosted nodes and community instances ready upon unlock!

zero_knowledge.title: Why Zero-Knowledge matters?
zero_knowledge.p1: On Facebook or X, your relationship graph is the primary commodity being sold. At DigitalPact.ca, we reject that model.
zero_knowledge.p2: Your invite link contains a secret key in the URL fragment (#k=...). This fragment never travels over the web to our servers. Your friends increment a blind counter without ever revealing who they are to each other or to us.
